Name: Horsecat - Ride your cat - Tiger mount
Author: Elvani
Description:
[size=3]Do you miss your cat when you're away from the farm? Then bring it with you! Ride your cat.

[b]Installation: [/b]unzip the file and put it in "Stardew Valley/Content/Animals". Back up the original horse.xnb if you want to uninstall this later.

This doesn't edit the pet sprite at all so if you don't want to have two cats (one as a pet and one as a mount), I recommend you use this mod with a pet skin as well. 

[/size][url=https://clips.twitch.tv/SpikyAffluentAntelopeHotPokket]Hey look a video of the mod by Haughington[/url]
